newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran officials' helicopter crash-lands safely-IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran officials' helicopter crash-lands safely-IRNA.

text.p: A helicopter carrying several Iranian officials crash-landed in southern Iran on Wednesday but no one was hurt, the official news agency IRNA said.
The incident occurred after a ceremony attended by President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, who was not on board the aircraft, the agency added.
It said the helicopter developed technical problems after taking off but was able to crash-land safely. Rafsanjani had inaugurated a copper plant in Kerman province.
